primary_task: Write, optimise and design SQL queries and schemas for a described database problem.

requirements.name: write (SQL code)
requirements.evidence: 3. **Write optimized queries** using modern SQL techniques

requirements.name: live database/warehouse (Snowflake, Aurora, BigQuery)
requirements.basis: lacks: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)

requirements.name: local database engine (PostgreSQL)
requirements.basis: bash: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads)

notes: Performance testing on real or cloud warehouses is not possible, but queries and schemas can be written and checked on a locally installed engine. If step 5 on a named cloud warehouse is mandatory, it would be BLOCKED.
